\begin{example} \end{example}[Standard isometries] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0196, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0197 1. ch31:31.8\group Hyperbolic isometries

Rotations of the disk are elliptic; translations parallel to the boundary in the upper half-space model are parabolic; and maps $(x',x_n)\mapsto (\lambda A x',\lambda x_n)$, $\lambda \ne 1$, are hyperbolic. \end{example}
